title: Verify Codex extraction semantics on a real Mac
description:
Pin from a real Mac: the exact harness-injected user-role content markers (instruction and environment wrappers riding along as user items) in the current codex-cli version; whether event_msg user_message kind (for example plain) reliably distinguishes genuinely typed input; the forked_from_id / forked_from_ordinal_exclusive skip semantics on real resumed rollouts; whether compressed rollouts appear on disk in normal CLI use (skip-with-note if so). Record findings.

Done when: each semantic is confirmed or corrected from real rollouts and encoded into synthetic fixtures; findings record the evidence.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: **Blocked from remote verification — needs Ryan's real Mac.** Implemented against the open-source openai/codex rollout format with synthetic fixtures; check locally and correct: (1) the exact harness-injected user-role content markers in the current codex-cli version (implemented: `<user_instructions>`, `<environment_context>`, `<turn_context>` wrappers — assumed spellings); (2) whether event_msg user_message `kind` (e.g. plain) reliably distinguishes genuinely typed input (implemented: event_msg mirrors are always skipped in favor of response_item); (3) the forked_from_id / forked_from_ordinal_exclusive skip semantics on real resumed rollouts (implemented: items with ordinal < forked_from_ordinal_exclusive are inherited and skipped); (4) whether compressed rollouts appear on disk in normal CLI use (skip-with-note if so). Record findings and correct the fixtures.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Verified all four Codex semantics against the real ~/.codex/sessions corpus on this Mac (233 rollouts, ~280k lines; structural fields only, no text recorded).

1. Harness-injected user-role content markers (current Codex Desktop-era rollouts): observed riding as user response_item texts: <environment_context> (99), <recommended_plugins> (173), <subagent_notification> (36), <turn_aborted> (5), <external_codex_apps_open_page> (19), <external_codex_apps_writing_block_edits> (1), <skill> (1), <realtime_delegation> (86), <in-app-browser-context ...> (33), <codex_internal_context ...> (41). The assumed <user_instructions>/<turn_context> wrappers do NOT appear as user-message text in this corpus — turn_context is now a top-level record type (2436 records), not a user message. All ten observed markers (plus the two documented ones) are now in CODEX_INJECTED_MARKERS. Untagged harness-ish prompts exist ("PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN:" x18) but are left unfiltered — not clearly injected, flagged here for a human call.

2. event_msg user_message: does not exist in current rollouts (0 occurrences in 124968 event_msg records; payload types are task_started, item_completed, token_count, task_complete, thread_settings_applied, turn_aborted, thread_goal_updated). Mirrors now happen via item_completed events. Skipping all event_msg records remains correct.

3. forked_from_id / forked_from_ordinal_exclusive: every top-level record carries a real ordinal field (ordinal,timestamp,type on all ~280k records). Fork behavior is mixed on real data: one fork starts at ordinal 29302 > forked_from_ordinal_exclusive 29298 (inherited items NOT re-recorded), while other forks re-record sparse inherited items below the exclusive ordinal (e.g. ordinals 4..227 with forked 29298). The adapter previously compared a counted position instead of the real ordinal — fixed to use parsed.ordinal for both the skip decision and record ids. Subagent rollouts (session_meta.source containing a subagent object, 151 files, 855 user messages, subagent_history_start_ordinal present) hold parent-delegation prompts, never typed input — now skipped entirely, mirroring Claude sidechains.

4. Compressed rollouts: yes, compaction appears in normal use — top-level compacted records (281) whose payload.message is a plain string summary plus replacement_history inside the payload. None of it is a response_item, so the adapter never double-counts or emits summaries; user messages continue after compaction as normal.

Also: session_meta has both id and session_id and they differ in 152/293 files (thread id vs session id); attribution keeps payload.id. All timestamps ISO RFC3339. Doctor unchanged (233 rollouts, 0 archived — archived_sessions/ absent is informational only).

Real-corpus effect: codex human messages drop from 2172 to 731 / 78 sessions over all time (delegation prompts and injected wrappers excluded). Fixtures updated with real ordinals, the observed marker set, a compacted record, an item_completed mirror, and a subagent rollout; subagent-skip and ordinal-fork tests added. 133 sentiment tests green.
